problem_text:
A logistics company must coordinate 10 delivery trucks to transport 10 different shipments across a distribution network.

Each shipment consists of a predetermined route through 10 transfer hubs, represented as pairs (Hub, Handling duration), where each pair specifies the hub where the shipment must be processed and the time required for handling. The sequence of pairs indicates the mandatory order in which the hubs must be visited.

Shipment details:
* S1 follows the route: (H2, 7) → (H5, 7) → (H8, 10) → (H7, 9) → (H3, 5) → (H10, 10) → (H4, 8) → (H9, 7) → (H6, 4) → (H1, 3)
* S2 follows the route: (H8, 2) → (H5, 6) → (H3, 2) → (H1, 1) → (H9, 4) → (H2, 2) → (H6, 10) → (H4, 6) → (H10, 9) → (H7, 1)
* S3 follows the route: (H5, 1) → (H8, 1) → (H7, 1) → (H1, 4) → (H2, 2) → (H3, 1) → (H6, 8) → (H9, 2) → (H4, 5) → (H10, 4)
* S4 follows the route: (H9, 1) → (H6, 9) → (H7, 10) → (H2, 10) → (H8, 7) → (H5, 10) → (H10, 8) → (H4, 3) → (H3, 7) → (H1, 10)
* S5 follows the route: (H9, 6) → (H10, 10) → (H2, 7) → (H8, 7) → (H5, 5) → (H7, 4) → (H3, 7) → (H4, 7) → (H1, 10) → (H6, 7)
* S6 follows the route: (H9, 6) → (H4, 6) → (H8, 8) → (H1, 10) → (H7, 5) → (H5, 10) → (H10, 9) → (H3, 2) → (H6, 1) → (H2, 2)
* S7 follows the route: (H5, 5) → (H3, 7) → (H10, 5) → (H6, 2) → (H2, 9) → (H1, 10) → (H8, 1) → (H9, 1) → (H4, 3) → (H7, 4)
* S8 follows the route: (H2, 8) → (H7, 10) → (H3, 2) → (H6, 9) → (H5, 4) → (H9, 9) → (H8, 8) → (H1, 3) → (H4, 8) → (H10, 10)
* S9 follows the route: (H6, 8) → (H4, 10) → (H3, 3) → (H1, 7) → (H8, 1) → (H9, 9) → (H7, 1) → (H2, 9) → (H5, 4) → (H10, 9)
* S10 follows the route: (H10, 6) → (H6, 4) → (H1, 2) → (H7, 7) → (H2, 4) → (H8, 3) → (H5, 4) → (H4, 8) → (H3, 10) → (H9, 7)

Once a shipment begins processing at a hub, it must continue without interruption until complete. Each hub can only handle one shipment at a time. The objective is to schedule the processing sequence of all shipments at the hubs so that the total completion time for all shipments is minimized.
